values.wording: Shall the Mandan Code of Ordinances be amended to prohibit large-scale and multiple data centers with a designed, contracted, requested, or reasonably anticipated electrical capacity or aggregate electrical demand of 25 MW or more within the City of Mandan and within certain territory subject to the City of Mandan zoning authority?
values.yes_effect: Approve the initiated ordinance summarized above
values.no_effect: Reject the initiated ordinance summarized above
values.scope: One-page city-hosted approved summary. Printed newspaper-publication date and online-location fields are blank; no publication proof or completed final ballot inferred.25MW includes equality, unlike Ohio greater-than25 definitions.
